faq.q: How much does Fraser Immigration Law charge?
faq.a: Fraser Immigration Law publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Fraser Immigration Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Fraser Immigration Law does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does Fraser Immigration Law have offices?
faq.a: Fraser Immigration Law publishes one office, in Miami Beach. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Fraser Immigration Law?
faq.a: Fraser Immigration Law names four attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
